ORDER nd Petitioner is aggrieved by the 2 respondent in trying to dispossess the petitioner from the business premises of the petitioner for the proposed road widening which the 2nd respondent has undertaken.
It is submitted that the 2"^ respondent has issued notice dated 15.07.2025 calling upon the petitioner to surrender the land belonging to the petitioner and given TDR bonds at the ratio of 1:4.
